result:
Clean lint, clean typecheck, and the full test suite (617 tests) plus my own lifecycle checks all pass. Summary of the backend implementation:

- **`src/config/constants.ts`**: added `ORG_SLUG_HOLD_DAYS = 30`.
- **`src/schemas/organization.ts`**: added `renameOrganizationSlugSchema` / `RenameOrganizationSlugInput`.
- **`src/server/db/schema/organizations.ts`** + **`src/server/db/migrate.ts`**: new `organization_slug_history` table (`orgId`, `slug`, `retiredAt`), unique on `(orgId, slug)`.
- **`src/server/repositories/organization-repository.ts`**: `findOrgBySlug` now falls back to a still-held retirement record (the single chokepoint also used by the session layer and every other slug lookup); added `isSlugAvailableForRename` (refuses a slug held current — live or archived — or retired by another org) and `renameOrgSlug` (ends the org's own retirement of the target slug if any, retires the old slug, writes the new one); `listTakenOrgSlugs` now also treats held retirements as taken so signup-time derivation can't collide with a slug mid-hold.
- **`src/server/services/organization-service.ts`**: added `renameOrganizationSlug` — permission-checked like `org:update`, no-ops on rename-to-current-slug, refuses unavailable slugs, otherwise renames and emits `organization.slug_changed` once.
- **`src/types/event.ts`**: added `organization.slug_changed` to `TaskflowEventMap`.
- **`src/types/activity.ts`**, **`src/schemas/activity.ts`**, **`src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts`**, **`src/server/services/activity-service.ts`**: added the `organization.slug_changed` audit action everywhere the others are accepted, including a listener that records it with subject kind `organization`, subject id the org's id, and `{ from, to }` metadata.

No existing test encoded the old (immediate-release) slug behavior, so none needed updating.
